profile_I.refinement: bounded chi refinement of every base-grid local-minimum bracket and endpoint-adjacent minimum; each chi evaluation reoptimizes nuisance parameters using the frozen start recipe
profile_I.selection: compare all refined candidates and endpoints under frozen objective-tie tolerance
profile_I.PASS: unique lowest refined candidate is interior and reproduces fitted optimum within numerical-only tolerance
profile_I.NEED_MORE_INFO: edge/tied/nonregular/failed refinement unless N already classifies pure numerical refusal
profile_I.true_chi: validation-only; never enters eligibility grid, starts, refinement, tie decision or row label

alias_rule.certificate: for underdamped C candidates damped frequency < fn <=45 Hz <60-Hz Nyquist; validator also checks discrete pole angle in (0,pi) and candidate frequency remains within the frozen domain
alias_rule.ambiguity: demonstrated observational equivalence from distinct admissible continuous lineages => S=REFUSE; missing certificate => S=NEED_MORE_INFO

retention_floor.rule: FRAMEWORK_NOT_OPERATIONAL if any control-rate cell has zero QUALIFICATION_ELIGIBLE rows among its 16 fixed replicates
retention_floor.scope: existence/operability only; not prevalence or performance threshold
